collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: A nickname, a mobile number or email for verification, and what you share with us in the conversation and follow-up.

access.title: Who sees your file
access.body: Only the clinical supervisor and your therapist. The technical admin team can't see your clinical data.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.body: We remove your name and numbers before any text is sent to the model, and your words are never used to train it.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: The original conversation is deleted 90 days after your file is approved, and the clinical record is kept according to the applicable regulations.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: See your data, download it, ask for it to be deleted, and withdraw any consent.

scope.title: What the service covers
scope.body: Tamaneen connects adults in the pilot region with licensed therapists for remote sessions. The AI assistant only helps with organization; treatment decisions are made by a human professional.

notEmergency.title: Not an emergency service
notEmergency.body: Don't rely on the platform when you're in immediate danger. If you're in danger now, call the emergency number or use the Help now button.

security.title: Keeping your account safe
security.body: Keep your password and recovery codes private and don't share them with anyone. Tell us right away if you think someone else has accessed your account.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.body: Use the service for yourself and in good faith, and treat therapists and the team with respect. Don't record sessions or share their content without permission.

ending.title: Ending the service
ending.body: You can stop using the service and ask for your account to be deleted at any time in settings. We may close an account that breaks these terms, and we'll point you to suitable alternatives.
